mechanism_narrative: A low current federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.25%) signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.25% (as of decision date), or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 8.0% (as of decision date), it signals severe labor market deterioration that triggers risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 8.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and residential sales (RSAFS) signals a housing sector contraction that precedes broader economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline (by > 0.5% month-over-month) simultaneously, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL annualized inflation rate > 2.5%), a decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the last 3 months signals aggressive monetary policy to prevent recession, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL (annualized inflation rate) > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS declines (by > 0.1% over last 3 months), or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A current industrial production index (INDPRO) level above 100 (2017=100) signals robust economic activity and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO > 100, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 900,000 units (as of decision date), it signals a housing market contraction that precedes economic weakness and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 900000, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals labor market deterioration that triggers risk-off sentiment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where both PAYEMS declines (by > 0.5% month-over-month) and UNRATE increases (by > 0.1pp) simultaneously, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In low GDP growth regimes (GDPC1 annualized growth rate < 1%), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals housing sector weakness that precedes further economic deterioration, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 (annualized growth rate) < 1% and HOUST declines (by > 0.5% month-over-month), or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
